verses.en: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
verses.pt: Louvai ao Senhor. Bem-aventurado o homem que teme ao Senhor, que em seus mandamentos tem grande prazer!
verses.en_web: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
verses.en_bbe: Let the Lord be praised. Happy is the man who gives honour to the Lord, and has great delight in his laws.

verses.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.pt: A sua descendência será poderosa na terra; a geração dos retos será abençoada.
verses.en_web: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
verses.en_bbe: His seed will be strong on the earth; blessings will be on the generation of the upright.

verses.en: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.pt: Bens e riquezas há na sua casa; e a sua justiça permanece para sempre.
verses.en_web: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
verses.en_bbe: A store of wealth will be in his house, and his righteousness will be for ever.

verses.en: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.pt: Aos retos nasce luz nas trevas; ele é compassivo, misericordioso e justo.
verses.en_web: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
verses.en_bbe: For the upright there is a light shining in the dark; he is full of grace and pity.

verses.en: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
verses.pt: Ditoso é o homem que se compadece, e empresta, que conduz os seus negócios com justiça;
verses.en_web: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
verses.en_bbe: All is well for the man who is kind and gives freely to others; he will make good his cause when he is judged.

verses.en: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
verses.pt: pois ele nunca será abalado; o justo ficará em memória eterna.
verses.en_web: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
verses.en_bbe: He will not ever be moved; the memory of the upright will be living for ever.

verses.en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
verses.pt: Ele não teme más notícias; o seu coração está firme, confiando no Senhor.
verses.en_web: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: He will have no fear of evil news; his heart is fixed, for his hope is in the Lord.

verses.en: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
verses.pt: O seu coração está bem firmado, ele não terá medo, até que veja cumprido o seu desejo sobre os seus adversários.
verses.en_web: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
verses.en_bbe: His heart is resting safely, he will have no fear, till he sees trouble come on his haters.

verses.en: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
verses.pt: Espalhou, deu aos necessitados; a sua justiça subsiste para sempre; o seu poder será exaltado em honra.
verses.en_web: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
verses.en_bbe: He has given with open hands to the poor; his righteousness is for ever; his horn will be lifted up with honour.

verses.en: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.pt: O ímpio vê isto e se enraivece; range os dentes e se consome; o desejo dos ímpios perecerá.
verses.en_web: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
verses.en_bbe: The sinner will see it with grief; he will be wasted away with envy; the desire of the evil-doers will come to nothing.
